title: The Net Comes First
concept: A museum collection room where everything is catalogued, next to a world nobody has been out to look at. The film holds one named beetle against a field of dashed unnamed contours, reveals that the curator who pins them co-authored a neural network that named ground beetles at 97.5 percent in 2008, and lands on the step the machine cannot do: somebody has to go out with a net.

angle.thesis: Alaska's insect count moves about a thousand species a decade and it is not because nobody built the algorithm. The curator pinning the specimens co-authored a neural network that named ground beetles from DNA at 97.5 percent in 2008. The step that is starved is the one before the model.
supporting_facts: c7/c8/c9: Systematic Biology 2008, DOI 10.1080/10635150802032982, 97.50 percent on 80 unknown ground beetle sequences, and D.S. Sikes is one of four authors
c1/c2/c10/c11: per ADN about 30,000 possible against about 9,000 identified, growing about 1,000 a decade, which is about 21,000 unnamed and about 210 years by our own arithmetic
c4/c5/c6: the collection went from about 1,000 records to more than 400,000, covering about 2 million pinned specimens, each born digital at intake
angle.fair_counter_point_it_must_honor: A 2008 back-propagation network tested on two well-studied groups is not a 2026 model, and nobody has tested a modern one against this constraint. The film says so out loud at line 15 and draws it. The collection itself is also the genuine win: two million specimens are the asset any future method has to read first.
runners_up: ALASKA'S SELF-KNOWLEDGE (analyst A): kept its 210-year scale reveal as the signature shot, but lost as the lead because the thesis has no AI hinge and this is an AI channel.
THE FRONTIER, A GENUINE WIN (analyst C): kept as the button and as the fair counter-point, but lost as the lead because on its own it says nothing about where the technology binds.

treatment.logline: The machine that could name Alaska's insects has existed for eighteen years, and the thing it is waiting for is a person in a field with a net.
treatment.judge_reasoning: The Explainer wins because this story's whole payload is an arithmetic and a mechanism, and both are drawable: 21,000 unnamed against 1,000 a decade is 210 years, and the chain classifier-sequence-specimen-net is a cutaway with moving parts. Grafted from the Dramatist: the open loop, holding back WHO wrote the shortcut until 46 seconds. Grafted from the Enthusiast: the button, where two million pinned specimens stop being a backlog and become the asset. Grafted from the Comedian: the NameEngine's empty intake opening and closing on nothing, the film's one running gag, which is also its thesis.
treatment.the_turn: The intake iris opens on nothing. The chain runs backwards from the machine to a hand holding a net.
treatment.the_button: Back at the drawer wall, the one named beetle still lit, and the question of what Alaska should actually buy.

fingerprint.palette: cabinet green, bone specimen paper, brass, one named-species teal
fingerprint.metaphor: a room that has a place for everything, and a world that has not been brought into it

palette: cabinet green #1E332C, bone #EDE7DA, brass #C9963F, named-species teal #35C8C0 (reserved), shadow #101A17
divergence_note: The last two dispatches were a warm smoke-haze field (08-03) and a warm brass bench under one lamp at macro-closeup on a single-object void (08-02). This film inverts all three of the signature axes against 08-02: eye-level-immersive rather than macro-closeup, grid-modular rather than single-object-void, and vertical-descent rather than horizontal-traverse. It also runs cool where both ran warm, and its hero is an ANIMAL where the last five heroes were machines and instruments. The register moves from tactile-collage to naturalistic-scene and the camera from track-follow to rise-reveal, so seven of nine axes differ from the most recent fingerprinted board.

hook.frame1: A ground beetle, fully drawn and form-shaded, large and dead centre on a bone field. It is the most finished thing this film will draw, and it lasts 0.35 seconds.
hook.headline: 21,000 ALASKA INSECTS HAVE NO NAME
hook.motion_at_frame_1: at 0.35s the beetle is STRIPPED to a dashed contour in a single hard pass, which is a real interrupt (something is taken away) rather than a plate easing in
hook.loopback: the button restores a beetle to the filled state beside this same still-dashed contour

open_loop.what: line 2 promises that somebody already built a machine to close the gap, and refuses to say who until line 9 names the four authors and the last one is the curator we have been watching pin insects for thirty seconds

reveals.what: one open drawer pulls back into a wall of unit trays as the catalog counter passes four hundred thousand
the 2008 study assembles into the NameEngine, part by part, gene window then intake then name plate
THE SIGNATURE SHOT. From the one named beetle out to nine thousand filled forms below and a field of dashed contours above that keeps going past the top of frame, with 210 YEARS landing
the chain classifier-sequence-specimen resolves into a single human hand closing on a net handle
